title: The card reads uplift and streams from how people say them (dclab-core 0.121.0)
request: The 45 written people played again live: 12 of Claude's 19 misses were cards that read another family.
plan: Read the 12 first messages and the card's rules for the families they missed.
Change only what the data story says plainly (an offer given to some and not others; sensors on machines), never a technique's name.
Measure the card on every written dev person's first message before and after: no other family may change.

decisions.decision: Streams before anomaly when the words describe machines' sensor readings.
decisions.why: Sensor readings over time are the streams kind's own data; 'anomaly' there names what the person wants to see, not the kind of problem.

decisions.decision: Uplift from an offer given to some and not to others, a discount wasted on people who would buy anyway, a promo some already got.
decisions.why: Each says a treatment and a comparison group, the uplift kind's two needs.

change: dclab_core/card.py WORDS['uplift'] three patterns; _family: streams before the anomaly branch when both match and no rare-event word; CHANGELOG 0.121.0.

findings.defect: Uplift and streams said in everyday words were read as nothing or as anomaly.
findings.scenario: JH-uplift-000 ('emailed a 15% discount to some customers and not to others... not waste discounts on people who would buy anyway'): no family; JH-streams-001 ('pumps... sensors send data every minute. need anomaly detection'): anomaly.
findings.cause: The uplift words knew 'would have bought anyway' and 'not those who buy anyway' only; the anomaly branch came before streams.
findings.fix: Three uplift patterns; streams first when sensor readings and anomaly words meet.
findings.test: the dev measurement below; harness HRN-053

measurements.name: the card's family from the first message, written dev people of three writers
measurements.gate: no other family's reading may change; right up, wrong not up
measurements.result: 649 people: right 107 -> 113, wrong 86 -> 84, unread 456 -> 452; streams 23 -> 25 right, uplift 5 -> 9; no other family changed
limits: first messages only; the conversation reads more

outcome: Two everyday ways of saying uplift and streams now reach their kinds.
lessons: Read the data story, not the technique the person names.
